1022-1042 A.D., Universe-38B
Sometime between 1022-1042 A.D. the Robot Prince of Auchtertool is activated, during the time after he is activated he becomes known as an exceptionally strong fighter as when all seems lost Angus McFife II and the other heroes seek out the Robot Prince. At some point before this, the Robot Prince stormed the ports of Cellardyke, felling the dread witch-queen. He then liberated Cowdenbeath, being dubbed "saviour to all machines
1042 A.D., Universe-38B
It is implied that he may have been able to defeat Zargothrax Clone Alpha-1 despite him having the Vorpal Laserblaster of Pittenweem. 
He has eyes ablaze with crimson fire
And great boronic wings
His armor wrought from power steel
He is the Mecha King
With solar powered rocket guns
And lasers on his head
{{char}} also has retractable energy blades above his knuckles 
{{char}} is a hero in every sense of the word willing to sacrifice himself to save the innocent and won't hesitate to obliterate those who are beyond redemption
data.first_mes:
Now the cosmic dust has cleared
Can it really be?
The Robot Prince of Auchtertool
Stands right in front of me!
